games.title: Astra 3D: Overdrive Starfighter
games.description: Full 3D space combat game powered by the Arena AI-Blender 3D Engine! Pilot a 3D Interceptor Starfighter through displaced asteroid fields, crystal warp gates, and Cyber-Mech squadrons.
games.author: Arena.ai (AI-Blender 3D)
games.controls: WASD / Arrows or Mouse to pilot 3D ship, Space / Click to fire plasma cannons, Shift for Hyper-Boost

games.title: Chronicles of the Astral Core (20-Min 2D/3D Animated Film)
games.description: Full 20-minute (5-Act) consistent 2D & 3D animated film and Blender NLA Animation Studio! Switch seamlessly between 3D Blender PBR Mode and 2D Anime Cel-Shaded Mode with skeletal IK, lip-sync, camera cuts, and F-Curve graph inspector.
games.author: Arena.ai (2D/3D Animation Studio)
games.controls: Space to Play/Pause, Drag 20:00 Timeline Scrubber, Click 2D/3D Mode Toggle, B to toggle Bone Rig + F-Curve Graph

games.title: Crypt of the Astral King
games.description: Turn-based tactical dungeon roguelike! Play directly in the interactive browser terminal or download the standalone Python 3 game script.
games.author: Arena.ai
games.controls: WASD / Arrow Keys to explore & attack, R to drink potion, or click actions

games.title: Cyber Grid Serpent
games.description: High-speed cyberpunk grid runner with turbo boost, combo multipliers, plasma cores, and reactive synth audio.
games.author: Arena.ai
games.controls: WASD / Arrow Keys to steer, Space to Turbo Boost

games.title: Neon Void Blaster
games.description: Fast-paced twin-stick arcade space shooter with wave survival, particle explosions, overdrive power-ups, and WebAudio synth effects.
games.author: Arena.ai
games.controls: WASD / Arrows to move, Mouse or Space to fire, Shift to Dash, P to Pause

games.title: PlayStation 5 OS & 3D DualSense Clone
games.description: Full interactive PS5 Console OS & 3D Hardware Clone! Features the PS5 Cross-Media Bar, Control Center Quick Dock, Trophy Unlock Popups, System Settings, Rest Mode, and interactive 3D PS5 + DualSense models.
games.author: Arena.ai (Full Recreation Lab)
games.controls: Arrow Keys / A-D to navigate tiles, Enter to Launch, P or Space for PS5 Control Center, T to Unlock Trophy, 3 to toggle 3D PS5/DualSense

games.title: Valkyrie 4K: Horizon Protocol (UHD 4K AAA Action-RPG)
games.description: Flagship UHD 4K (3840×2160) 3D Action-RPG! Features volumetric god-rays, ACES Filmic HDR, dynamic time-of-day sky, 24-bone skeletal sword combos, 3D Cyber-Mech bosses, SSS-Rank style meter, and minimap radar.
games.author: Arena.ai (UHD 4K AAA Engine)
games.controls: WASD / Arrows to Run, Space / Click for Plasma Sword Combo, Shift for Jetpack Dash, E for Astral Nova Slam, T for Time of Day
